description: The pie chart, titled “Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM),” visually breaks down the distribution of token routing across three categories in the FedHLM framework: LOCAL, EDGE_P2P, and LLM. The largest segment, occupying 94.5% of the chart and colored green, corresponds to LOCAL token routing. A smaller red segment labeled LLM accounts for 3.9%, while the smallest slice, colored blue and labeled EDGE_P2P, represents 1.6%. The chart uses a simple color-coded legend implicitly through direct labeling on each slice, and the segments are arranged with the largest portion dominating the visual field, while the two smaller segments are grouped together on the upper left, slightly offset to emphasize their relative proportions. The caption clarifies that this illustrates the token resolution breakdown among local processing, peer-to-peer transmission, and large language model involvement in the federated learning context.
